title: Earthband
summary: Earthband is a defensive spell that projects a barrier that can redirect incoming attacks at will. This spell is used by Hoffman.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Hoffman used this spell in Peru to deflect Dante Vale's Touchram. This was in turn, however, was redirected by Januseea the Gatekeeper back at Hoffman. [Doorway to Huntik]

Later, Hoffman used the spell to redirect a Boltflare from Sophie Casterwill at Lok Lambert. He then attempted to use the spell against the Willblade but it was disabled by Sophie's Shieldbreaker spell. [The Blood Spiral]

'''Earthband''' is a defensive spell that projects a barrier that can redirect incoming attacks at will. This spell is used by [[Hoffman]].

== History ==
Hoffman used this spell in [[Peru]] to deflect [[Dante Vale]]'s [[Touchram]]. This was in turn, however, was redirected by [[Janusea the Gatekeeper|Januseea the Gatekeeper]] back at Hoffman. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}}

Later, Hoffman used the spell to redirect a [[Boltflare]] from [[Sophie Casterwill]] at [[Lok Lambert]]. He then attempted to use the spell against the [[Willblade]] but it was disabled by Sophie's [[Shieldbreaker]] spell. {{source|The Blood Spiral}}
